description: 先发现太极，让五行在实验台上展开。
description_en: Discover Taiji to open the five phases.

description: 沿着水的变化，收集蒸汽、云、雨与河流。
description_en: Follow water through steam, clouds, rain and rivers.

description: 从一粒种子开始，寻找根、植株与林。
description_en: Begin with a seed and discover roots, plants and forests.

description: 试着把材料变成陶器、玻璃与砖。
description_en: Make pottery, glass and bricks from raw materials.

description: 收集纸、墨、书与印刷，留下你的造物记录。
description_en: Collect paper, ink, books and printing.

description: 找到轮、齿轮、机械与动力机之间的联系。
description_en: Connect wheels, gears, machines and engines.

description: 从电路走到传感器和计算机。
description_en: Build a path from electricity to sensors and computers.

description: 发现细胞、代谢、循环与内稳态。
description_en: Discover cells, metabolism, circulation and homeostasis.

description: 集齐望、闻、问、脉诊，再发现四诊合参。
description_en: Collect the four examinations and bring them together.

description: 找到四大经典，让收藏中出现这一组纪念。
description_en: Discover all four classics and complete their collection.

description: 把六个生命概念联系起来，完成终极收藏。
description_en: Connect the six foundational concepts and complete their collection.

description: 集齐七大原理，回看它们各自的合成来路。
description_en: Collect the seven principles and revisit their synthesis routes.
